# RobotStudio SO-101 (6-DOF, upgraded SO-100)

<p class="sr-chips"><span class="sr-chip sr-chip-family" data-family="arm">Arms</span><span class="sr-chip">6 joints</span><span class="sr-chip sr-chip-sim">sim</span><span class="sr-chip sr-chip-real">real</span><span class="sr-chip sr-chip-driver">driver: lerobot, strands</span></p>

<robot-viewer name="so101"></robot-viewer>

```python
from strands_robots import Robot

robot = Robot("so101")
```

Real hardware, one call per driver that builds it:

```python title="sketch"
robot = Robot("so101", mode="real", port="/dev/ttyACM0")  # lerobot so101_follower
robot = Robot("so101", mode="real", driver="strands", port="/dev/ttyACM0")  # FeetechDriver
```

Aliases `Robot()` accepts: `robotstudio_so101`, `so101_dualcam`, `so101_follower`, `so101_tricam`.

| Model joint | Action key |
|---|---|
| `1` | `shoulder_pan` |
| `2` | `shoulder_lift` |
| `3` | `elbow_flex` |
| `4` | `wrist_flex` |
| `5` | `wrist_roll` |
| `6` | `gripper` |

Gripper actuator `6`: closed at the low end of travel, open at the high end.

## Hardware

**lerobot.** `Robot("so101", mode="real")` builds lerobot's `so101_follower` with `pip install 'strands-robots[lerobot]'`; `port=` is the serial device, `cameras=` the lerobot camera dict. The default when `driver=` is not given.

**`FeetechDriver`** (selected with `driver="strands"`) speaks Feetech STS/SMS serial bus: [port, SDK, kwargs and checks](../learn/hardware/drivers.md#feetechdriver).

Model: [google-deepmind/mujoco_menagerie/robotstudio_so101](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco_menagerie/tree/c96a32d28fb5da84da38c1da4d749e7a13212855/robotstudio_so101), scene `scene.xml`.
